gloss: to sprinkle over; to scatter on top of

definitions.gloss: to sprinkle over; to scatter on top of

examples.japanese: ご{飯|はん}にふりかけを{振|ふ}りかける。
サラダに{塩|しお}とコショウを{振|ふ}りかけた。
examples.english: I sprinkled salt and pepper on the salad.

examples.japanese: {仕上|しあ}げに{粉|こな}チーズをたっぷり{振|ふ}りかけると、{風味|ふうみ}がぐっと{増|ま}す。
examples.english: Sprinkling plenty of grated cheese on top as a finishing touch greatly enhances the flavor.

notes:
A compound verb from {振|ふ}る (to shake, scatter) + かける (to apply onto), meaning to sprinkle or scatter something onto a surface. Most commonly used in cooking contexts.

USAGE:
- Almost always used for dry or fine ingredients (salt, pepper, spices, cheese, sesame seeds)
- The noun ふりかけ (rice seasoning) derives from this verb
- Can also be used figuratively, e.g., {水|みず}を{振|ふ}りかける (to sprinkle water)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塩|しお}を{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle salt
- ごまを{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle sesame seeds
- {粉|こな}チーズを{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle grated cheese
- パセリを{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle parsley
- {水|みず}を{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle water

SIMILAR WORDS:
- まぶす: to coat evenly; implies covering the entire surface
- {散|ち}らす: to scatter; broader meaning, not limited to cooking
- かける: to pour over; used for liquids rather than dry ingredients
